home.subtext: Ollie ari hano kuganira, kukumva, no kuguma nawe.

settings.title: Igenamiterere
settings.deleteHint: Ibi bitangiza igihe cyo gutegereza mbere y'uko konti yawe n'ibiyirimo byose bisibwa burundu. Kwinjira mbere y'uko igihe kirangira bihagarika iyi gahunda. Andika {{phrase}} kugira ngo wemeze.
settings.freqNormalDescription: Igitondo, umugoroba, no kureba uko umeze
settings.freqFrequentDescription: Kenshi kurushaho, akareba uko umeze vuba niba udahari
settings.locationHint: Kugira ngo Ollie avugane nawe nk'umuturage — avuge ku muco wawe, iminsi mikuru, n'ibirimo kubaho aho utuye.
settings.clearMemory: Siba ibyo Ollie azi kuri wowe
settings.logOutMessage: Ushobora kwinjira ubundi igihe cyose ubishatse.
settings.clearMemoryMessage: Ollie azibagirwa byose yize kuri wowe — ibyo ukunda, ibyo wasangiye, n'imico yabonye. Ibi ntibishobora gusubizwa inyuma.
settings.toastExportError: Ntibyashobotse kohereza amakuru yawe, ongera ugerageze
settings.toastLocationError: Ntibyashobotse guhindura aho uherereye, ongera ugerageze
settings.toastDeleteScheduled: Gusiba konti byateganyijwe. Injira mbere y'uko birangira kugira ngo ubihagarike. Turagusohora…

ourSpace.title: Umwanya wacu
ourSpace.loadError: Ntibyashobotse gupakira urugendo rwawe, ongera ugerageze
ourSpace.nothingYetDescription: Komeza kuganira na Ollie — ubwibutsa bwawe, intego zawe, n'ibyo mwagezeho hamwe bizatangira kugaragara hano.

premium.title: Gura Premium
premium.description: Ubutumwa budafite umupaka, ubwibutsa burambuye, n'ibiganiro mu ijwi na Ollie.
premium.monthlyDetail: Byishyurwa buri kwezi · reba igiciro igihe uriho kwishyura
premium.yearlyDetail: Byishyurwa buri mwaka · reba igiciro igihe uriho kwishyura
premium.footnote: Kwishyura biroherewe neza. Uhagarika igihe cyose ubishatse.
premium.successBody: Murakoze gushyigikira Ollie. Bishobora gufata amasegonda make kugira ngo bitangire gukora — niba ikiganiro kigikwerekana umupaka, tegereza gato hanyuma ufungure porogaramu ukundi.
